verdict.rationale: A live probe shows Better Stack serves its docs as raw markdown at /docs.md (HTTP 200), which an agent can ingest directly. However, /llms.txt returns 404, and nothing in the pack documents agent-oriented docs as a feature. The MCP server is a separate capability and earns no credit here. missing for 10: an llms.txt / llms-full.txt index, documented agent-oriented docs (e.g. per-page .md variants advertised for LLMs), evidence that markdown coverage extends beyond the getting-started page, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://betterstack.com/docs.md # Getting started
